lemmas.statement: Invalid index routes to ClosureFailure for any mass.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_invalid (mass : Nat) : evaluate_gin_fermion_recovery false mass = TerminalRoute.ClosureFailure := invalid_gin_routes_to_closure_failure mass

lemmas.statement: Valid index with zero mass routes to Repair.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_repair : evaluate_gin_fermion_recovery true 0 = TerminalRoute.Repair := exact_gin_cancellation_routes_to_repair

lemmas.statement: Valid index with positive mass routes to SplitBrainRefusal.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_refusal (mass : Nat) (h : mass > 0) : evaluate_gin_fermion_recovery true mass = TerminalRoute.SplitBrainRefusal := residual_sign_routes_to_refusal mass h

near_misses.claim: Repair routing means the fermion sign problem is solved.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Repair is only a routing tag for zero uncancelled sign mass on a valid index; no sign-problem solution is claimed.

near_misses.claim: An invalid index with zero mass routes to Repair.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Invalid index routes to ClosureFailure regardless of mass.
